recentItems.title: Nigel Farage's Reform U.K. accused of breaking foreign funding law after undercover investigation
recentItems.description:

Reform denies wrongdoing, saying it was the victim of a hoax. CBS News reporter Inaya Folarin Iman has the details.

recentItems.title: Witkoff, Kushner to visit Moscow and Kyiv in renewed push to end Russia-Ukraine war
recentItems.description:

John Herbst, former U.S. ambassador to Ukraine and Uzbekistan, joins with analysis.
